top_signals.title: Traders and Investors Want to Exercise Their Convictions: Bilal Little
top_signals.summary:
Bilal Little, global ETF strategist at Direxion, joins Scarlet Fu on a special edition of “Bloomberg Markets.” Providers have filed for more than 20 exchange-traded products to amplify daily moves on Anthropic, both on the upside and the downside, as firms including Direxion, ProShares and GraniteShares jostle for a first-mover advantage. The Direxion ETFs will start trading Monday.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: China Sells $2 Billion of Dollar Bonds as Xi, Trump Meet
top_signals.summary: China sold $2 billion of dollar-denominated sovereign bonds on Thursday as leaders of the world’s two largest economies met in Shenzhen.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
